notes:
• The pencil on a saved entry now has Set times, so you can change when the work started and stopped.
• Close on save no longer goes missing when ConnectWise is slow to answer as a ticket opens.
• Close ticket from the right-click menu now picks Closed even with a timer running.
• On a phone, booking from My time now lands on the day you're looking at instead of today.
• For managers: the hours in To review now have the same minus and plus buttons as everywhere else.
